verdicts.reason: Both break the reading order the same way. 'PRAY' sits above 'When Life Is Great', 'When Life Is Rough' drops down to the left at a different size, and the divider line is stranded at the bottom with no link to the text. The rose is also cut into a hard-edged rectangle, losing the original's soft vignette. B is slightly worse: the rose sits further in from the left edge, so 'When Life Is Rough' nearly touches the leaves and the text block on the right is pushed tight against the edge. A at least leaves a gap between the image and the text.
